facts.fact: Afghanistan is home to the world's largest Buddha statues carved into cliffs at Bamiyan, which stood for 1,500 years before their destruction in 2001.
facts.flagElement: the large standing rectangle in the center

facts.fact: Afghanistan produces over 90% of the world's lapis lazuli, the brilliant blue stone prized since ancient times and traded along the Silk Road.
The snow leopard, one of the world's most elusive big cats, roams the Hindu Kush mountains of Afghanistan at elevations above 10,000 feet.
facts.flagElement: the white diagonal stripe with circular spots
